title: CPU Temperature in Fahrenheit
line: System Monitor widgets now show temperatures in °F when your region uses US measurement units.
explanation: libksysguard's Formatter, which every System Monitor widget and the System Monitor app use to display sensor values, only knew Celsius, so temperatures were shown in °C regardless of the user's region settings. The change converts Celsius values to Fahrenheit and shows °F when the locale's measurement system is Imperial US (the Measurement Units setting in Region & Language), the same rule the Weather widget follows. The chart range spin boxes keep a °C label because ranges are stored in the sensor's own unit.

commits.message:
formatter: show temperatures in Fahrenheit for US measurement units

Temperatures were always shown in Celsius, even when the region settings
use US measurement units. Now they are converted to Fahrenheit in that
case, while chart range settings keep using Celsius as they are stored.

BUG: 466917

media.caption: US locale (en_US, the tray weather shows °F): both widgets show CPU temperatures in °C.
Same session with the fix: values, legend and chart axis are in °F (0 °C axis floor shows as 32 °F).
Line chart settings: the manual Y range stays labelled °C, matching how the range is stored.
With LC_MEASUREMENT=en_GB (metric) the widgets still show °C.
